thread:
deploy-bot: publishing staggered cohort 2 for redwood-sdk (py/ts). opt-out window 15m.

nina: FYI CI detected 3/30 signature-verify failures on wheels in canary-2. not a full revoke, but above our 5% threshold.

omar_sdk: can we avoid yanking? recommend removing canary dist-tag and republishing fixed artifact. for python, release 1.4.1 with patch and for npm publish new canary tag.

sre_julie: agree - policy: only remove artifacts on security. We'll pin cohort 2 routing to 1.4.0 until fixed. creating pin now.

deploy-bot: routing pin created: `pin redwood-sdk cohort=2 version=1.4.0 reason="signature-verify-fail"`

devex_lead: decision: pause cohort promotions for 30m, notify affected customers, do targeted opt-outs if requested. Omar, cut patch release and run smoke across 25 samples.

omar_sdk: cutting 1.4.1 now. will run build+sign step locally then push.

deploy-bot: smoke job queued: `ci/smoke-canary-2` -> results expected in ~12m.

deploy-bot: smoke-canary-2: FAILED (3/25 signature-verify). threshold breached -> keep pin and hold cohort. linking logs: https://logs.internal/1755559999/canary2

nina: support alerted customers and posted temporary guidance: pin to 1.4.0.

omar_sdk: re-signed and re-published 1.4.1-signed. re-run smoke.

deploy-bot: smoke-canary-2: PASS (0/25 failed).

devex_lead: OK to unpause cohort 2 and remove routing pin. follow-ups: add gating test to prevent signer rotate during publish windows and add a brief postmortem note.

sre_julie: will draft rollback playbook for registry anomalies and attach to the release tracker.

nina: adding release-note blurb about temporary hold and fix.

omar_sdk: publishing changelog and closing the cohort incident. :white_check_mark:
